evidence.mission_note: As an S52 manual M Roadster this matches the preferred future-keeper engine, but it is a keeper purchase priced above the ideal band. It conflicts with the current cash-preservation and bridge-first strategy.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: the VIN decodes to a 1998 Z3 M convertible, which puts it on the S52 engine by year, and the AutoCheck summary shows a clean title, no reported accidents and 5 previous owners. Photos show a visually stock, clean-looking Arctic Silver car with original M wheels and a black interior; the underside, engine bay, tire dates and top are not examined here. No maintenance records are offered, so both model-critical items — rear subframe/trunk-floor integrity and cooling-system history — are missing, which matters more on a New England car. Nothing is observed wrong mechanically, so known work is not established. The $21,986 ask plus a $395-$495 doc fee sits about 13% above the $19,443 fair-value mid. The listing has run 535 days unsold under a no-haggle policy. PPI access for this out-of-state, appointment-only dealer is not stated.
